name: Synn
message: 「Hmm~ How should I make up with Macaron...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I thought I'd try coming up with something clever to say while doing a bit of gardening.」
Even though I want to go see her right now.
Maybe both Macaron and I need some time to cool our heads.

name: Macaron
message: 「...Alright, big brother and the others aren't around.」

name: Macaron
message: 「After yesterday, it'd be super awkward if we ran into each other today...」

name: Sally
message: 「What's the deal~? You're gonna startle me too.」

name: Macaron
message: 「What are you guys doing in a place like this?」

name: Sally
message: 「We're on our way back from eating beef bowls♪ What about you, Mako-chii?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm heading to my part-time job now.」

name: Macaron
message: 「What? Is there something on my face?」

name: Macaron
message: 「No, it's not! Nothing's bothering me at all!」

name: Sally
message: 「Really? And here I had a great Demon World Mail-Order item for you...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm not worried about anything at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, as thanks for promoting KiraFes. Is it that late already?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no. We're the ones who should be thanking you.」

name: Sally
message: 「I got a part-time job at the beef bowl shop together with Boss♪」

name: Sally
message: 「This is a~ll thanks to you, Prez.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「It's because you and Eauderourke worked so hard, Sally.」

name: Sally
message: 「Ehehe~ Well, maybe I am pretty great~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「You haven't been causing any trouble for the beef bowl shop, have you?」

name: Sally
message: 「They were shocked when they first saw us, sure, but it looks like they've gotten totally used to us by now.」
Humans and Demons really can get along well together like this.

name: Sally
message: 「So anyway, we were thinking of thanking you, Prez.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah. We'll lend you a hand anytime if it's for you, Prez!」

name: Sally
message: 「Call us anytime you've got something tasty, okay.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「I... feel like I'm finally getting motivated!」
It feels like I might even be able to make up with Macaron.

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, right away, could I ask you guys for a little favor?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm going to harvest the vegetables, so I'd like some help carrying them.」

name: Sally
message: 「So hey, where are we taking this stuff?」

name: Sally
message: 「If it's Mako-chii you're looking for, she was in the shopping district?」

name: Sally
message: 「She said she has a part-time job.」
Even after everything that happened yesterday, she still shows up properly for her part-time job.
I wonder if this is also for the sake of becoming the Demon Lord...

name: Synn
message: 「No. I'd feel bad interrupting her work, so I'll save it for next time.」

name: Sally
message: 「What're you gonna do with the veggies?」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's just leave the ones that won't spoil by the side of the tent.」

name: Synn
message: 「As for the rest, you and Eauderourke can go ahead and have them.」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Ode, eat, veggies. Being picky, no good.」

name: Synn
message: 「Now then, maybe I'll head back and start prepping some vegetable curry.」
I wonder if the day we can live peacefully alongside Demons is still far away.
